scope: Functionality comparison after current Inspector refinements; proposed evidence only, not implementation authorization.
method: Current WinUI/Transmission/Session source plus independent qBittorrent inventory. Official Transmission main RPC spec consulted for standard external boundaries. No builds, tests, GUI, production edits or extra agents.

comparison_source.note: Source snapshot, not claim about current installed release.

status_legend.exists: Current UI or current contract already performs the workflow.
status_legend.loaded_unshown: Data already in current selected detail projection but not rendered.
status_legend.rpc_exists_not_exposed: Existing mutator capability can provide an absent presentation/shortcut.
status_legend.rpc_not_required: Pure local OS/presentation workflow; no daemon command needed.
status_legend.unsupported_standard_rpc: No corresponding command in inspected standard RPC/current wrapper; engine-internal or custom extensions not proven.
status_legend.unverified_or_requires_policy_change: Cannot promise functionality from current data/lifecycle; version/capability/retention must be decided.
status_legend.loaded_unshown_version_dependent: DTO exists, but daemon-version field presence must be established.

priority_scale: 1=high-value feasible workflow/data refinement; 2=useful after bounded design/capability review; 3=unsupported, niche or retention-policy change to defer.
constraints: Preserve intentional Synapse torrent table and approved Pieces-map appearance.
Reuse single Session.Request/current-tick snapshot, single tracker/general draft, single page modal/clipboard/local-open authority.
Native contextual actions and TreeView hierarchy, no second generic file table/control system.
No new timer/RPC client/hidden payload cache/palette/dependency.

current.detail: No Files Open action, double-click open or tree Enter-open handler. Existing Enter handler only transfers focus from file search/editor to tree. General Open opens the torrent DownloadDir.

capability.boundary: Local OS workflow, not a Transmission RPC. Existing local connection identity, DownloadDir, relative file Path, Length and Completed are sufficient to attempt opening a known completed local file. A remote daemon path is not a local path.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: TorrentPage existing local shell-launch owner; Inspector only supplies captured file path/target and native command wiring.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Offer Open only for one actual local file with meaningful known completion; use the existing launch/error route, never a second process-launch helper.

risks: Resolve relative path under captured local DownloadDir using native path APIs; preserve root containment.
Incomplete download directory/.part filename is not represented by the current file DTO; do not advertise exact incomplete-file opening.
Actual local existence, registered handler and OS errors require runtime validation.

findings.workflow: Open a selected file's containing folder or selected folder

current.detail: General Open reaches torrent root only. Files footer has full relative path but no per-path containing-folder action.

capability.boundary: Local connection and a captured relative path permit local folder navigation; remote paths cannot be opened through the user's OS.

proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Extend existing local-open route to a captured contained folder path; expose a native Files action/context command rather than a new file browser.

risks: File path may not yet exist or data may be elsewhere while incomplete.
Selection may change during a queued command; capture target/path before launching.
Folder commands should distinguish torrent root, selected folder and containing folder.

findings.workflow: Use right-click or keyboard context menu for selected file actions

current.detail: Native CommandBar offers Download, Skip, Priority and Rename; no Files MenuFlyout/context wiring is present.

capability.boundary: All existing wanted/priority/rename commands are real and can be invoked from another native presentation. Local Open/Folder remains a separate local-only capability.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector existing ChangeFiles, RenameFile, SelectedPaths and shared page modal gate.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: One native contextual MenuFlyout calls the same command methods for a captured/native accepted selection; do not duplicate wanted/priority/rename implementations.

risks: Right-click on an unselected row must have explicit native selection behavior, not silently mutate previous selected files.
Keyboard ContextMenu/Shift+F10 must reach the same selection and native flyout.
Do not add independent draft/modal flags.

findings.workflow: Toggle download inclusion from the selected tree row(s)

current.detail: Wanted is read-only Yes/No/Mixed/Unknown. Alt+W Download and Alt+K Skip commit the selection; no Space wanted-toggle shortcut or inline wanted checkbox.

capability.boundary: TorrentSet.FilesWanted and FilesUnwanted already support captured original ordinal arrays; no new backend capability is needed.

proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: A deliberate tree-only wanted shortcut can call the existing direct command. Define mixed-selection policy once (for example all wanted => Skip, otherwise Download); retain read-only Wanted and native tree selection.

risks: Native TreeView Space may already select; explicit product design is required before repurposing it.
Guard exact modifiers, native popup/editor priority, Live presence and IsCommitting.
No empty ordinal array: Transmission treats empty file arrays as all files; current ChangeFiles protects this.

findings.workflow: Sort displayed files by name, size, progress or priority

current.detail: Header is descriptive, not sortable. Tree builds in original torrent-file enumeration order; no sort direction state or sort commands.

capability.boundary: Current UI wrappers expose Name/Length/Completed/Priority. Sorting is a presentation operation; original leaf Index must remain the RPC identity.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: InspectorFile tree projection plus Inspector's existing view/layout owner.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Start with one explicit sibling Name sort if justified. Keep folders/hierarchy and original indices; use native command/header presentation without creating another generic table/control system.

risks: Folder grouping, natural/culture filename ordering and unknown/mixed values need a written policy.
Do not sort flat DTO ordinals then send displayed position as index.
Do not Clear/Move displayed collections or rescan every file for each frame; selection/expansion preservation requires source review and runtime verification.

findings.workflow: Find nested files and expand/collapse folders efficiently

current.detail: Native multi-select TreeView starts folders collapsed. File search is relative-path substring; nonempty search switches to a flat list of matching leaves. No Expand all/Collapse all or saved expansion is exposed.

capability.boundary: Current native TreeView handles hierarchy; existing roots/Children/Path can support bounded navigation. Wildcards/regex/drag export are product features, not missing RPC.

proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Preserve substring search and native hierarchy; if users need it, one scoped Expand/Collapse command for current folder is smaller than global eager expansion or a second navigator.

risks: Search deliberately flattens matching leaves; full Path tooltip/selected facts are necessary for duplicate basenames.
Automatic recursive expansion can realize many rows and defeat compactness.
Actual deep-tree keyboard/scroll performance and high text-scale geometry remain unverified.

findings.workflow: Add, edit or remove tracker URLs

current.detail: Edit opens full Announce URLs draft. Adding/removing/replacing text then Save sends the entire tiered list. Ctrl+C copies full selected URL. No individual Add/Edit/Remove row menu, F2 editor or Delete remove command.

capability.boundary: TorrentSet.TrackerList implements all list CRUD. Standard RPC also lists deprecated tracker_add/remove/replace, recommending tracker_list; new request types are unnecessary.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector sole Tracker edit baseline/lifetime and SaveDraft.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: If direct CRUD is desired, native row commands should modify/enter the existing TrackerList draft with captured selected URL/tier and existing confirmation. Reuse full-list Save; no parallel per-row RPC path.

risks: Duplicate URLs/tiers must be mapped from TrackerList rather than blind global string replacement.
Concurrent external edits can be overwritten by whole-list save; existing staged baseline is the authority.
Known rejection preserves draft; uncertain mutating RPC must not be automatically repeated.

findings.workflow: Move tracker between tiers or change primary ordering

current.detail: Blank lines in Announce URLs define tiers; users can reorder URLs/groups manually. Table shows one-based Tier and Primary/Backup but no Up/Down or tier command.

capability.boundary: Tier/order is represented in TrackerList and TrackerStats.Tier/IsBackup. Standard whole-list RPC already supports it.

proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Keep list editing as complete functionality; optional native Move to tier command should edit the same draft and Save path, not add a second tier model.

risks: Backend Primary/Backup is operational selection, not a stable user-set radio option.
Tier row selection and draft text must resolve duplicated URLs without an independent catalog.
Do not copy qB protocol-specific tier behavior that is unavailable in Transmission.

findings.workflow: Force announce to one selected tracker instead of whole torrent

current.detail: Reannounce sends TorrentReannounce with selected torrent Hash only; tracker row selection does not narrow operation.

capability.boundary: Standard torrent_reannounce accepts torrent ids only, no tracker id/URL selector. Current request shape matches it.

proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Retain truthful torrent-wide action. Do not offer selected-tracker reannounce unless a custom daemon API is separately evidenced.

risks: Label/tooltip must not imply selected tracker scope.
No speculative custom RPC or remove/readd workaround.
Backend announce cooldown/acceptance remains daemon policy.

findings.workflow: Diagnose the original discovery sources of current connected peers

current.detail: Peers summary shows connected/supplying/receiving; PeersFrom counts are already loaded but not rendered. Preferences exposes PEX, DHT and local discovery session controls.

capability.boundary: TorrentPeers.PeersFrom contains FromCache/Dht/Incoming/Lpd/Ltep/Pex/Tracker. Upstream maps RPC peers_from to peer_from_count, incremented on connection creation and decremented on disconnect, classified by original from_first/fromFirst. These are connected-peer provenance counts, not counts of actively transferring peers, service health, historical total discoveries or fake tracker rows. Modern known_peers_from is a separate counter not in this projection.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector existing Peers summary/selected facts; Session remains detail snapshot authority.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Conditional compact discovery facts in Peers, using current counts. If linking to settings, route existing Preferences owner rather than duplicate discovery toggles in Trackers.

risks: Do not equate connected-source counts with actively supplying/receiving peers, healthy discovery services or unique global population.
Zero count is a valid value, not necessarily disabled/unsupported.
Session feature enable state is separate from torrent discovery-source counts.

current.detail: Only nonzero active webseed count is appended to Peers summary. Full Webseeds string URLs are fetched but no list/copy workflow is exposed.

capability.boundary: TorrentPeers.Webseeds is current standard read projection; no additional RPC/timer needed. Modern upstream webseeds_ex can expose more per-source detail but is not current contract.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector Peers current detail view; shared clipboard owner.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: A conditional compact read-only native source list/disclosure in Peers with URL copy is smaller than adding a seventh HTTP Sources tab. Do not hold hidden source payload.

risks: URLs are provenance/source strings; opening them is not equivalent to opening downloaded content.
Long URLs need finite scrolling/full copy, not unbounded default field dump.
Modern per-webseed rate/state requires version support and a current DTO before display.

findings.workflow: Add, edit or remove HTTP sources

current.detail: No webseed mutation commands or editor.

capability.boundary: Inspected current standard torrent_set documents no webseed add/remove/edit mutation, and TorrentSet has no such fields. Read support does not establish write support.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: No production owner should be added for unsupported mutation.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Expose read/copy first; defer editable sources until an actual supported daemon command is evidenced.

risks: Do not simulate CRUD by altering metainfo/readding torrent, which changes task/lifetime semantics.
qB capability comes from its different engine API.
Custom daemon extensions, if any, were not proven in this audit.

findings.workflow: Manually add an endpoint or permanently ban a peer

current.detail: Peers has table/diagnostics/copy only. Session-wide blocklist preferences exist; no individual endpoint add/ban request.

capability.boundary: Inspected standard RPC has no peer-add or individual permanent-IP-ban method. Blocklist URL/enabled plus blocklist_update is a different session-wide mechanism, not a substitute.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Keep peer copy in Inspector and blocklist management in existing Preferences/Session owners.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Do not add dead Add/Ban controls. If custom engine support later exists, design explicit session-wide ban scope/confirmation first.

risks: No inference of unsupported engine-internal functions from standard RPC absence; conclusion is specifically current external contract.
A peer endpoint includes port; permanent IP ban has broader scope.
Local blocklist file writes would require a separate authorized backend workflow and are not ordinary peer UI editing.

findings.workflow: Copy hash, magnet or location while data loads, changes view or disconnects

current.detail: Copy hash reads retained selected row.Hash. Copy path and magnet require matching loaded General details; detail Release hides/clears ordinary loaded values, while dirty editor lifetime can retain drafts. General local Open is based on configured connection identity.

capability.boundary: Hash available from light row; magnet/location values come from existing current General projection. No copy RPC is needed.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector current matching-detail availability projection and page single clipboard/local-open authority.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Keep current stale-target protection. Any offline copy improvement should use an already authoritative retained row field, not a hidden General cache.

risks: Retained editor text is not proof of loaded current target metadata.
CopyMagnet should not re-query silently or create an independent state authority.
Hash algorithm is not exposed as separate v1/v2 identifiers in current contract; do not label current HashString as both.

findings.workflow: Read active/seeding durations, last activity and provenance

current.detail: Latest refinement exposes known Last activity in Transfer details; Added/Completed and Creator/Created/Comment exist. SecondsDownloading/SecondsSeeding/StartDate and Source are loaded but unshown.

capability.boundary: Current TorrentGeneral contains these values. Source is a source/provenance string; this audit does not establish it as the original HTTP add URL or an actionable URL.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Inspector ShowGeneral existing conditional Transfer/Information projections.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: If prioritised, add compact known download/seeding duration diagnostics to existing disclosure; conditionally show meaningful Source without assuming URL semantics.

risks: ActivityDate is backend activity time, not Last seen complete; qB's fact cannot be relabelled onto it.
No independent clock/timer needed for backend cumulative durations.
Unknown timestamps and incomplete metadata must remain truthful; avoid dumping all loaded fields.

findings.workflow: Read a specific throughput/time value from the graph

current.detail: Per-torrent current rates, observed seconds and both peaks are shown. Two traces use actual timestamps and joint auto peak. No visible axes, tick labels, rate scale or hover readout.

capability.boundary: Current bounded SpeedSample timestamps/rates are sufficient for compact scale/hover facts; no RPC needed.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Existing SpeedView plot plus Inspector Speed labels; Session remains sole samples owner.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Add the smallest factual displayed rate/time bounds or selected hover facts using current samples, with accessible text. Preserve both traces/gaps and finite geometry.

risks: Auto scale can change as old peaks leave history; unlabeled shape is not a stable absolute scale.
Accessible keyboard alternative must not create many plot focus stops.
qB graph is session-wide; selected-torrent units/scope must remain explicit.

findings.workflow: Choose longer observation periods or graph categories

current.detail: Current selected-torrent view observes at most 32 two-second samples (roughly 62 seconds span continuously); observations stop when hidden. No period selector, persistent long history or overhead/DHT/tracker categories.

capability.boundary: Longer selected-torrent history requires changed bounded retention policy. Session aggregates exist separately, but per-category qB traces are not in current SpeedSample/SessionStatistics contract.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Core existing SpeedHistoryBuffer/Session observation authority if a new retention requirement is accepted; never UI-owned timer/history.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Do not add qB period menu before data exists. First clarify need/scope and memory budget; keeping current short observed history is a deliberate lean boundary.

risks: Background history retention conflicts with current release-hidden policy unless explicitly revised.
Whole-session graph in torrent properties can mislead selection scope.
More samples/categories need executable/memory/runtime justification; no currently proven source for category payloads.

findings.workflow: Locate a selected file/folder's pieces in the existing map

current.detail: Files DTO already includes BeginPiece/EndPiece; current InspectorFile does not expose them and Pieces map only shows all pieces. No file-to-range navigation.

capability.boundary: Supporting Transmission 4.1/RPC6 supplies file piece ranges. Older standard versions omit them; current nonnullable ints default to zero, so absence is not distinguishable by value alone.

proposed_minimal_owner.owner: Core current FileCatalog/contract for support truth; Inspector captured file range command; existing PiecesView selection/highlight range owner.
proposed_minimal_owner.minimal: Only after capability verification, a Files Show pieces command can enter the existing map and focus/highlight captured range(s). Preserve approved whole-map appearance and no second map/file-range framework.

risks: Begin/end inclusivity and zero-length/shared-piece behavior must be confirmed against actual engine, not guessed.
Do not infer older zero ranges as file genuinely occupying piece zero.
Multi-folder selection can contain noncontiguous ranges; no misleading min/max contiguous span.
Map aggregates ranges to fit viewport; highlight must not replace map semantics or retain hidden all-file payloads.

next_verification: Native TreeView Space/context behavior and deep-tree selection
Actual negotiated BeginPiece/EndPiece support and inclusivity

additional_data_boundaries.current: General edits per-torrent DownloadLimited/DownloadLimit, UploadLimited/UploadLimit and HonorsSessionLimits. Session exposes AltSpeedEnabled plus SeedingLimits; these are insufficient to report the actual effective rate ceiling.
additional_data_boundaries.needed: Existing session_get supports regular global limit values/enabled flags, alternative limit values and current alternative activation. UI Preferences Settings has these properties, but the current Core SessionStatus tick projection does not. Effective bandwidth-group limits may also apply and are not represented in current General/Session data.
additional_data_boundaries.minimal_owner: Only if accepted, extend the existing Core SessionStatus projection/read and expose one truthful effective-limit projection; Inspector displays it. No inspector query, timer or calculation from seeding globals.
additional_data_boundaries.risk: Distinguish configured per-torrent limit from effective inherited constraints; alternative mode and global competition are not seeding conditions. Do not promise measured throughput from a maximum ceiling.

semantics_verification.peers_from: Verified against upstream main: rpcimpl.cc make_peer_counts_map reads tr_stat.peers_from; torrent.cc stats maps swarm_stats.peer_from_count; peer-mgr.cc updates it on connection create/remove keyed by from_first. Transmission 4.0.6 peer-mgr.cc likewise updates peer_from_count on create/remove keyed by fromFirst. This is current connected provenance, not current transferring activity or known-peer inventory.
semantics_verification.runtime: Actual daemon version and returned field population were not queried.
